title: Voice-Light: A Full-Duplex Cascaded Voice Agent with Causal Turn-Taking and Speculative Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.20995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural spoken interaction requires more than streaming ASR, language generation, and speech synthesis: a system must react to overlap without canceling on every acknowledgment, prepare a response before a turn is certain, and ensure canceled audio cannot enter conversation history. We present Voice-Light, a full-duplex cascaded voice agent that combines immediate acoustic onset, a causal adapter sharing a streaming ASR encoder, reversible playback control, and private speculative response generation. Structured tool calls execute concurrently with audible bridge speech, while browser acknowledgments make rendered audio authoritative for durable history. Locked evaluation on 1,673 real-conversation silence candidates found that an earlier learned completion checkpoint preserved a 2.70% false-cutoff rate but reached only 12.53% end-of-turn recall, compared with 95.60% for a Silero timing policy. translated_title: Voice-Light：具备因果轮次切换与投机生成的全双工级联语音代理
translated_abstract: 自然的口语交互不仅仅需要流式语音识别（ASR）、语言生成和语音合成：系统必须能够对说话重叠做出反应，而不是在每次听到确认语时就取消输出；必须在轮次尚未确定之前就预先准备响应；并确保被取消的音频不会进入对话历史。我们提出了Voice-Light，一个全双工级联语音代理，它结合了即时声学起始检测、共享流式ASR编码器的因果适配器、可逆播放控制以及私有的投机响应生成。结构化工具调用与可听见的桥接语音并发执行，而浏览器端确认机制使已渲染的音频成为持久对话历史的权威来源。在1,673个真实对话静音候选样本上的锁定评估发现，较早的学习完成检查点虽然保持了2.70%的误切断率，但轮次结束召回率仅为12.53%，而Silero定时策略的召回率达到了95.60%。因此，部署的系统保留了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Voice-Light是一个全双工级联语音代理，通过即时声学起始检测、共享ASR编码器的因果适配器、可逆播放控制和私有投机生成，实现了自然的实时口语交互，既能正确应对说话重叠又保证被取消的音频不污染对话历史。
en_tdlr: Voice-Light is a full-duplex cascaded voice agent that achieves natural real-time spoken interaction by combining immediate acoustic onset detection, a causal adapter sharing a streaming ASR encoder, reversible playback control, and private speculative generation, enabling correct handling of overlapping speech while keeping canceled audio out of conversation history.
